juridique.title: Legal Services
juridique.subtitle: Your legal shield for informed decisions
juridique.p1:
At FMS, our legal department provides clients with sharp expertise and tailored support to secure all their operations.

From drafting complex contracts to managing disputes, regulatory compliance and strategic advice, our experienced lawyers are by your side at every stage of your development.

We guarantee a proactive, confidential service perfectly aligned with the realities of Congolese and international law.

mines.title: Mining Mandate
mines.subtitle: Mining expertise at the service of your rights
mines.p1:
FMS offers a comprehensive mining mandate service, supporting mining operators in all administrative, legal and technical procedures related to natural resource exploitation in the DRC.

Our specialized team ensures rigorous monitoring of your mining rights, from the creation of your mining company to maintaining the validity of your titles, including management of renewals and transfers.

We ensure that your activities permanently comply with the applicable technical and environmental requirements, allowing you to operate safely and legally.
mines.feature2: Management and assistance of mining disputes

rh.title: Human Resources Management
rh.subtitle: Human capital, the driver of your performance
rh.p1:
At FMS, our Human Resources division offers comprehensive, tailor-made support solutions for the development and management of your human capital.

We bring together within this expertise professional placement (temporary and permanent), strategic talent and executive recruitment, custom training programs, as well as performance management and evaluation.

Our mission is to help you attract, develop, and retain the best profiles while fostering team cohesion through our team-building workshops.

finance.title: Finance & Accounting Services
finance.subtitle: Secure and optimize your financial flows
finance.p1:
FMS assists companies in accounting, financial, and administrative management to secure their growth and optimize profitability.

Our Finance division gathers bookkeeping and accounting supervision, rigorous payroll management and social obligations, as well as independent external and contractual audits to bring transparency and compliance to your business.

We provide you with strategic steering tools and precise dashboards for sound decision-making.

about.title: Who Are We?
about.subtitle: Your Strategic Partner in Human Capital
about.description:
We are a simplified joint-stock company (SAS) specialized in supporting businesses through our 6 strategic services: Human Resources Management, Finance & Accounting, Tax Consulting, Immigration & Mobility, Legal Services, and our role as a Mining Mandant.

We assist our partners in managing and structuring their missions, delivering concrete solutions adapted to their operational realities.

We also support companies in setting up their business in the Democratic Republic of Congo, from strategic design to implementation, for sustainable growth.
about.history_text: Financial Managing Support is a simplified joint-stock company (SAS) that stands out as a strategic partner. Since our founding in 2018, we have built strong ties with our clients across the DRC and internationally, helping them transform their challenges into opportunities. We firmly believe that every company is unique. That is why our solutions are fully customized to meet the specific needs of our clients. By optimizing the efficiency of their teams, we allow them to focus on what really matters: their core business.
about.mission_text: Our mission is to turn your management challenges into our performance lever. Whether through taxation, finance, human resources, or many other fields, our human approach and expertise allow us to build partnerships of trust, thus contributing to the lasting success of every company we support.
about.vision_text: To be the Pan-African leader in HR consulting, recognized for its excellence, integrity, and innovation capacity.
about.value1_text: Exemplary rigor and specialized expertise in all our interventions.
about.value2_text: Irreproachable moral conduct and strict adherence to professional standards.
about.value3_text: Absolute protection of information and interests of our clients and partners.
